definitions.gloss: to liven up; to enliven; to boost
definitions.explanation: to make an event, atmosphere, or mood more exciting and energetic

definitions.gloss: to pile up; to heap up

examples.japanese: ⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{盛|も}り{上|あ}げよう!
DJ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{盛|も}り{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: The DJ got the venue pumped up.
He's good at livening up the atmosphere.

examples.japanese: ⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{山盛|やまも}り→山盛り：10157_yamamori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{盛|も}り{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: I heaped the rice into a mound.

examples.japanese: ⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{協力|きょうりょく}して→協力する：25370_kyouryokusuru⟧⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{盛|も}り{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: Everyone worked together to make the event a success.

examples.japanese: ⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{盛|も}り{上|あ}げて⟦{花壇|かだん}→花壇：11075_kadan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I piled up soil to make a flower bed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦サラダ→サラダ：01364_sarada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧{盛|も}り{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: I heaped the salad high on the plate.

notes:
{盛|も}り{上|あ}げる is a compound verb combining ⟦{盛|も}る→盛る：00292_moru⟧ (to heap, serve) + ⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ (to raise).

VERB TYPE:
- Ichidan verb (る-verb)
- Transitive
- Intransitive pair: ⟦{盛|も}り{上|あ}がる→盛り上がる：06344_moriagaru⟧ (to get excited, be in full swing)

SENSE 1 VS SENSE 2:
- Sense 1 (more common): To make something exciting, energetic - used with events, atmosphere
- Sense 2: Physical piling up of objects

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{盛|も}り{上|あ}げる (to liven up the atmosphere)
- ⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{盛|も}り{上|あ}げる (to liven up a party)
- ⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{盛|も}り{上|あ}げる (to create an exciting atmosphere)
- ⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{盛|も}り{上|あ}げる (to make an event exciting)

INTRANSITIVE PAIR:
- ⟦{盛|も}り{上|あ}がる→盛り上がる：06344_moriagaru⟧: The party/atmosphere itself becomes excited
- {盛|も}り{上|あ}げる: Someone actively makes it exciting

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{盛|も}り{上|あ}がる→盛り上がる：06344_moriagaru⟧ (intransitive: to get excited)
- ⟦{活気|かっき}→活気：02554_kakki⟧づける (to invigorate)
- ⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧ (to heighten)

REGISTER: Neutral. Very common in casual conversation.
